description: This file is a minified/concatenated JavaScript library for web components, including polyfills for URL, WeakMap, MutationObserver, HTMLTemplateElement, and performance enhancements, used in Polymer project.

classes.name: HTMLTemplateElement
classes.description: Polyfill for HTMLTemplateElement, enabling template content handling in browsers without native support.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill for WeakMap if not natively available.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: Polyfill for MutationObserver, providing DOM mutation observation capabilities.

classes.name: MutationRecord
classes.description: Represents DOM mutation records for MutationObserver.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.decorate
methods.description: Decorates a template element to support content and innerHTML property.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes all template elements in a document.

methods.name: jURL
methods.description: Custom URL class polyfill implementing URL interface.
